senses.gloss: , pl. אוּרְבָּנֵי m. (v. foreg.; cmp. עֲרָבָה) bulrushes.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 101a:2">Sabb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>קני ואו׳</he> (some ed. <he>ואר׳</he>) reeds and bulrushes.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82b:10">Snh. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>בין קני לא׳ וכ׳</he> what has Sh’vilnai (a woman) to do between the reeds and the bulrushes? (prov. for suspicious movements of women).
